findings.observation: On the 390px captures, the large promise, explanatory text, and “Plan a shop visit” introduction repeat in every state. In review and confirmation, the chosen details or result begin more than 550px down the page.
findings.impact: The reading path keeps returning to the opening pitch after the visitor has made a choice. The decision and its result arrive late.
findings.repair: Keep the full introduction for the initial choice screen. In later states, compress it so the selected service, time, and result lead the page.

findings.observation: At actual phone size, service descriptions and demo notices are very small, and the “INTERACTIVE DEMO” badge wraps into two tiny lines.
findings.impact: Text that explains the services and the demo’s limits is harder to read than the surrounding controls.
findings.repair: Increase the size of decision and demo text, and give the demo label enough room to read clearly.

strengths: The sturdy sans-serif voice suits a practical repair task, and the service names, prices, dates, and times scan clearly.
The selected state makes the chosen service and time distinct. The review state presents the exact choice, and the confirmation headline prominently says “Nothing booked.”
The page avoids a decorative editorial type preset; its strongest type hierarchy is tied to the service choices.
limits: The captures show rendered states only; they do not establish font identity, semantic structure, zoom behavior, or interaction behavior.

strengths: The service area, hours, services, prices, and sample times are clear at desktop and mobile sizes.
The selected state visibly marks both choices. The review repeats the service, price, time, and area, and offers a way to change the choice.
The final state states plainly that nothing was booked. The wheel mark, practical typography, and restrained palette suit a neighborhood bike shop.
limits: Static captures cannot verify pointer, keyboard, touch, focus, or screen-reader behavior.
Only one completed choice is shown; other service and time combinations and desktop review states are unverified.
